realizes.rationale: readRoleAgents stats the current role-agents path on access and reuses parsed facts only for the same path and dev/inode/size/mtimeNs/ctimeNs generation. A changed generation rereads and validates the file; ENOENT returns no records and read errors clear the cache, while malformed records fail visibly. New registration facts require no process reload or background polling; this is not a fresh physical file read/parse on every turn end.

1.note:
Absent configuration/file yields no records and malformed facts throw; equal stat identity reuses one parsed mapping until registration changes.
